scope: Native Chromium Web Locks and real user-click window.open sessionStorage cloning. Actual helper only, TypeScript-transpiled without application/SDK imports. No Worker/auth/accounts/providers/user data.

checks.name: Legacy unleased nonce is preserved but never reused; native lock owns the new versioned viewer nonce.
Real window.open copies the original sessionStorage, but the live child acquires a distinct nonce before ready.
Both native exclusive viewer locks are held concurrently.
Actual original-document reload releases/reclaims its nonce while the duplicated child remains distinct.
Releasing both actual helper consumers leaves no native viewer locks or queued requests.
